reason: I'd never heard of Nora Furnish and $360 is real money on my budget. There's no UL listing, no lumens and no install details, and my electrician is back in three weeks, so I can't gamble on a no-name light that might not pass.
objection: A brand nobody knows, no UL listing or lumens or mounting specs shown, and I pay return shipping if it doesn't work out. That's a lot of risk for $360 with a hard install date.
would_change_my_mind: A full spec sheet with UL/ETL listing, lumens, dimensions and canopy details, real customer reviews with photos, and free returns or a guaranteed in-stock delivery date before my electrician comes.
